scenario.name: r-cw-4-chain-depth
scenario.description: Chain depth hop counter: fires continue_work 3× in sequence, verifies hop increments from 1/200 → 3/200 in traced responses.
scenario.registryNotes: Runnable k6 scenario drives a supplied runner-provisioned session, or a disposable fallback session, through three sequential continue_work hops and final CW4-DONE sentinel.

expectedReceipts.name: hop-2-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Second continue_work accepted after wake, chain.step shows 2/N

expectedReceipts.name: hop-3-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Third continue_work accepted after wake, chain.step shows 3/N

expectedReceipts.name: trace-ids
expectedReceipts.description: Trace IDs from each hop for Tempo chain verification

expectedReceipts.name: final-done
expectedReceipts.description: Final continuation wake emitted CW4-DONE nonce sentinel

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_work tool → continuation.work → continuation.work.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash and length, holding one continuation.work span, its continuation.work.fire span(s), and the originating continue_work tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: Chain depth counter. PASS when 3 sequential hops show incrementing chain.step. Use OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true for an automatic proof subagent session, or supply an explicit reviewed session key.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_work tool span to continuation.work and continuation.work.fire only by shared trace and reason fingerprint. The manifest reason also carries a per-hop {{hop}} placeholder that collect-continuation-trace.mjs does not render, so the in-run collector cannot attribute this row’s three hops today and its trace receipts stay pending until per-hop traces are attached for review.

spans.name: continuation.work
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_work evidence. Joined to the accepted entry only by shared trace.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: The continuation reason is published only as a digest and a length, inside a public-safe Tempo projection. The raw reason, sentinel instructions, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: Three sequential continue_work hops are accepted with chain.step 1/N, 2/N, and 3/N, CW4-DONE arrives on the final wake, and the hops share one continuation chain.
controls.negative: A hop counter that does not increment, or a final sentinel without the third accepted hop, does not satisfy the row.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: All three hops accepted with an incrementing chain step and the final CW4-DONE wake sentinel. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Any hop or the final sentinel is missing. Missing or unattributable traces keep the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: Not emitted by this scenario: an incomplete run is PARTIAL-candidate. Neither trace receipt can produce or clear a FAIL.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cw-4-chain-depth.js fires three sequential continue_work hops in a disposable proof session.
execution.manual: Per-hop traces have to be located and attached by a reviewer until the collector can render the per-hop reason.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Sequential continue_work chain row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true; when enabled the scenario creates an agent:main:subagent:continuation-r-cw-4-* proof session so broad runs do not depend on a hand-supplied session_selector. Serialize per target session; do not run alongside other same-session continuation rows.
